result.instructions: Tools for Text-Em-All, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Text-Em-All data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run text_em_all_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run text_em_all_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run text_em_all_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. text_em_all_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: get_account
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Fetch your Text-Em-All account settings — company/billing info plus credit balances (AvailableCallUnits, CallBalance) used for sending. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/account. Use this first to confirm your credentials work.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.title: List broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts (text + voice campaigns) as a paged Feed { Size, Items:[...], Previous, Next }. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts. Filter with equals-style `params` (e.g. BroadcastStatus=Complete) and order with `sortby`. For date-range operators (StartDate~gte~2024-01-01) use the textemall_request escape hatch.

pagesize.description: Number of items per page (Feed `pagesize`, default 10).

takesize.description: How many items to return (Feed `takesize`; defaults to pagesize).

sortby.description: Comma-separated fields to sort by; prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. '-StartDate,CreatedDate').

params.description: Additional documented equals-style query filters to send verbatim (e.g. BroadcastStatus=Completed). For range operators (Field~gte~value etc.) use the textemall_request escape hatch. Merged with paging above.

tools.name: get_broadcast
tools.title: Get a broadcast
tools.description: Fetch a single broadcast by id, including its status and summary. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts/{id}.

tools.name: get_broadcast_details
tools.title: Get broadcast delivery details
tools.description: Fetch per-contact delivery details/results for a broadcast (who was reached, delivery status). Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/broadcasts/{id}/details.

tools.name: list_text_numbers
tools.title: List text numbers
tools.description: List the toll-free text (SMS) numbers on your account as a Feed. Each TextNumber has a TextNumberID you need to send a 1:1 conversation text (see send_text_message). Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/textnumbers.

pagesize.description: Number of items per page (Feed `pagesize`, default 10).

takesize.description: How many items to return (Feed `takesize`; defaults to pagesize).

params.description: Additional documented equals-style query filters to send verbatim (e.g. BroadcastStatus=Completed). For range operators (Field~gte~value etc.) use the textemall_request escape hatch. Merged with paging above.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List saved contact lists (groups you can broadcast to) as a Feed; each List has a ListID/ListName. Text-Em-All API: GET /v1/lists. NOTE: inferred from the API's List model — if your account/endpoint differs, use the textemall_request escape hatch.

pagesize.description: Number of items per page (Feed `pagesize`, default 10).

takesize.description: How many items to return (Feed `takesize`; defaults to pagesize).

params.description: Additional documented equals-style query filters to send verbatim (e.g. BroadcastStatus=Completed). For range operators (Field~gte~value etc.) use the textemall_request escape hatch. Merged with paging above.

tools.name: get_authorization_token
tools.title: Get a user authorization token
tools.description: Exchange a Text-Em-All account username + PIN/password for that user's authorization token (the value you set as TEXTEMALL_AUTH_TOKEN). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/user/login. Signed with your App/Secret key only (no user token yet). Returns { AuthToken }. Use this once to bootstrap; store the token in config thereafter.

username.description: The Text-Em-All website login username. Required.

password.description: The Text-Em-All website login PIN/password. Required.

tools.name: get_conversations_sso_url
tools.title: Get a single-sign-on conversations URL
tools.description: Generate a single-sign-on URL to the Text-Em-All conversations UI (open in a browser/iframe). Optionally scope it to one conversation thread by passing a toll-free textNumber + the other phoneNumber. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/singlesignon/conversations. Returns { Url }. No account data is changed.

textNumber.description: A toll-free text number on the account, e.g. 18885551234.

phoneNumber.description: A phone number that has a conversation with the text number, e.g. 9725551212.

tools.name: textemall_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any Text-Em-All API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the origin, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v1/broadcasts?StartDate~gte~2024-01-01&sortby=-StartDate" or "/v1/textnumbers". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the origin, starting with "/", e.g. "/v1/broadcasts?pagesize=50".

tools.name: create_broadcast
tools.title: Send a broadcast
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data AND SENDS MESSAGES (spends account credits): creates + sends a broadcast to the given contacts. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/broadcasts. Set broadcastType to 'SMS' (a text broadcast — provide textMessage) or 'Announcement' (a voice broadcast — provide voiceText for text-to-speech, or a pre-recorded AudioID via `fields.Audio`). Contacts is a list of { primaryPhone, firstName?, lastName?, notes? }. Extra documented fields (CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes, CallThrottle, MaxMessageLength, StartDate, CheckCallingWindow) go through `fields` (PascalCase). Returns the created broadcast.

broadcastName.description: A name/label for this broadcast (BroadcastName). Required.

broadcastType.description: 'SMS' for a text broadcast, 'Announcement' for a voice broadcast. Required.

textMessage.description: The text body for an SMS broadcast (TextMessage). Required when broadcastType='SMS'.

voiceText.description: Text-to-speech message for an Announcement broadcast (mapped to Audio.TextToSpeech=true + Audio.Text).

primaryPhoneNumbersOnly.description: Only send to each contact's primary phone number (PrimaryPhoneNumbersOnly, default true).

fields.description: Additional documented Text-Em-All fields to send verbatim in the JSON write body, using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes). Merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: send_text_message
tools.title: Send a conversation text
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data AND SENDS A TEXT (spends credits): sends a 1:1 conversation text message immediately from one of your toll-free text numbers to a single contact. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/conversations. You need a textNumberId (from list_text_numbers). Returns the conversation.

textNumberId.description: The TextNumberID of the toll-free number to send from (see list_text_numbers). Required.

truncateIfExceedsLimit.description: Truncate the message if it exceeds the length limit (TruncateIfExceedsLimit).

fields.description: Additional documented Text-Em-All fields to send verbatim in the JSON write body, using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes). Merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: create_draft_broadcast
tools.title: Create a draft broadcast
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data (creates a DRAFT — does NOT send anything): stages a broadcast with the given contacts and returns a single-sign-on URL to finish + send it in the Text-Em-All UI. Safer than create_broadcast when a human should review before sending. Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/draftbroadcasts. Returns { SingleSignOnUrl, ... }.

contacts.description: Contacts to pre-populate on the draft broadcast (each needs primaryPhone). Required.

fields.description: Additional documented Text-Em-All fields to send verbatim in the JSON write body, using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes). Merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: add_account_user
tools.title: Add an account user
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data: adds a new user to your account (a master user can do this). Text-Em-All API: POST /v1/account/users. Provide the user's fields via `fields` using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. UserName, FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Permissions). Returns the created user.

fields.description: Additional documented Text-Em-All fields to send verbatim in the JSON write body, using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes). Merged OVER the typed fields above.

tools.name: update_account_user
tools.title: Update an account user
tools.description: MUTATES Text-Em-All data: updates an existing account user. Text-Em-All API: PUT /v1/account/users/{user_id}. Provide the fields to change via `fields` (PascalCase, e.g. FirstName, LastName, EmailAddress, Permissions). The user_id is never sent in the body. Returns the updated user.

user_id.description: The id of the user to update (path only). Required.

fields.description: Additional documented Text-Em-All fields to send verbatim in the JSON write body, using the API's PascalCase names (e.g. CallerID, TextNumberID, Lists, RetryTimes). Merged OVER the typed fields above.
